notes.title: Version 3 released
notes.notes:
Hello all,

A new version has been released. It introduces experimental controller support.
Since this was an asked feature, it's being released early.

Changelog :

Units can retreat if in too low numbers (especially dogs).
Units are no longer afraid of grenades thrown on rooftops.
Fixed bug with flamethrower flame not hitting close targets.
Controller support (In game only, no UI).

notes.title: Version 2 released
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Thank you for supporting the game in these early stages!

A new version has just been released on steam : 
[list]
[*]Fixed bugs when trying to run a custom campaign.
[*]Added a custom campaign template (needs to be enabled by editing the campaign.json file).
[*]Added console output, run the game from the console to see it.
[*]Fixed wobbling objects when moving (crates,barrels etc).
[*]Reduced black vertical boundaries of maps and items can no longer escape.
[/list]


So this is only bug fixes. Mostly revolving around modding.

Now there is a beta branch that you can access in the properties>beta tab of the game on steam. 


[h1] So what's next? [/h1]

It has been a slow year start, so expect more activity in the future.

Still working on controller support, which is something that was requested.
Will process inputs from the community to tweak maps and gameplay.
AI will have more different behaviors, will differentiate dogs from soldiers.

A new campaign will be created later, as planned.

Linux version is done, just needs to be tested on steam before release, please contact me if you would like to be a tester.
